sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: New Beginning (Prestige 6) is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Hello-hello! I won't waste your time, let's get straight to the point. Our reputation is holding strong, but we want more and better, right? So we can't afford to slack off. The lists are updated all the time, and we can make it to the very top. All you have to do is complete everything on the list. Yes, it's tough, yes, it takes a while, but the reward matches the effort."

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text:
- Must be level 47 to start this quest.
- Must have Prestige level 5

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Eliminate 50 PMC operatives
- Eliminate 100 Rogues
- Locate and neutralize any Boss with a headshot
- Eliminate 5 hooded men
- Survive and extract from The Lab
- Use the transit from Streets of Tarkov to Interchange
- Use the transit from Interchange to Customs
- Use the transit from Customs to Reserve
- Survive and extract from Reserve
- Hand over the found in raid item: BEAR operative figurine
- Hand over the found in raid item: Politician Mutkevich figurine
- Hand over the found in raid item: Killa figurine
- Hand over the found in raid item: Reshala figurine
- Hand over the found in raid item: Ryzhy figurine
- Hand over the found in raid item: Scav figurine
- Hand over the found in raid item: Tagilla figurine
- Hand over the found in raid item: USEC operative figurine
- Hand over the found in raid item: Cultist figurine
- Hand over the found in raid item: Den figurine

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +11,000 EXP
- Ragman Rep +0.1
- 3,000,000 Roubles
  - 3,150,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 3,450,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
- 3× Physical Bitcoin
"I knew you wouldn't let me down! You and I make a great team, right?"
